assumptions.statement: Official SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons are not bundled in this local draft; geometry is provisional and must be replaced and fully recomputed when official data is available.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-derived areas, ratios, route lengths and figure extents are conceptual only.
assumptions.trigger_to_recalculate: Organizer publishes official boundary and key-area GeoJSON or equivalent machine-readable polygons.

assumptions.statement: AI Origin Community, Dazhongsi and Zhongzhiyuan are used as conceptual role anchors for daily service, transfer/night interface and controlled testing.
assumptions.impact: This does not confirm official land use, ownership, program, access, capacity or operator.
assumptions.trigger_to_recalculate: Official key-area polygons, planning documents, ownership, transport and operational conditions are confirmed.

assumptions.statement: External pages and peer proposals remain citation-only references; every submitted diagram, chart, HTML page, PDF, raster figure, geometry layer and embedded font bundle has a row in the detailed file-level ledger in report/copyright_statement.md. Proposal text, geometry and visual compositions are original local assets; the embedded Noto Sans CJK SC subset is used under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
assumptions.impact: The current repository package and PR display have a documented rights basis. This clearance does not authorize adding external images, logos, map tiles, screenshots, datasets or fonts without a new ledger row and license record.
assumptions.trigger_to_recalculate: Before any future public-display adaptation or asset addition, re-audit every visual asset, font rendering dependency, source URL, license and attribution record; unresolved rows must block that adaptation.

assumptions.statement: The proposal discusses route continuity and transfer experience, not approved roads, rail projects, station entrances, traffic-control plans or engineering layouts.
assumptions.impact: Transport geometry remains a design test and must be checked against official transport and safety data.
assumptions.trigger_to_recalculate: Official transport base map, station interfaces, road hierarchy, accessibility survey and professional review become available.

assumptions.statement: The concept uses aggregated or synthetic events and does not require personal trajectories, health records, child identity or sensitive behavior data.
assumptions.impact: Any pilot requiring personal data needs a separate privacy, security, consent and governance review.
assumptions.trigger_to_recalculate: A real pilot defines data fields, retention, access, consent and incident response.
